saw_lines: Home textile buyers compare fabric and colour across tabs, then wait for a reason to commit, usually a sale or free delivery.
So the sale is won or lost in line one, where price and delivery doubts get answered or the buyer scrolls on.
Your site shows 10,000+ happy homes, yet 0 of 28 ads carry that number. Put 10,000+ on every creative and in the first line, and open two ads with a review quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 28 Oct 2026
points: Your site shows 10,000+ happy homes, yet 0 of 28 ads carry that number, so buyers in the feed never see it. Put 10,000+ on every creative and in the first line, then open two ads with a review quote.
Your site offers 5% off orders of ₹1,499 and up, yet 0 of 9 fixed copy ads mention it, so new buyers get no reason to act. Put the 5% off in line one of three new ads and on the creative.

Your site explains shipping, yet 0 of 28 ads mention shipping or delivery, so a buyer wondering about arrival simply scrolls past. Answer it in the first line of three new ads: free prepaid shipping and 10k+ pin codes.

19 of 28 ads are product feed ads with no written story, so the feed shows items without a reason to choose this brand. Add three story ads opening on a styled bedroom, using the curtains and bedsheets on your site.

ads_1: Review led curtain and bedsheet ads opening on 10,000+ happy homes
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, Pinterest and Youtube
